BiblicalUsage: Eleph is a place in Palestine. In Joshua 18:28, the text says "Eleph." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eleph matters because God's story happened in real places, and Eleph is one of them.
